name: ChimpJar Shoppable Videos
author: chimpjar

sections.description:
ChimpJar Shoppable Videos is the ultimate tool for modernizing your website’s user experience. Inspired by TikTok and Instagram Reels, this plugin allows you to add a floating video bubble that captures attention and drives sales.

Perfect for product demos, testimonials, or special announcements. Build high-converting video widgets with ease.

Key Features:

  • Floating Video Widget: Display a professional video bubble on any page.
  • Multi-Video Gallery: Add multiple videos to your widget gallery.
  • Easy Widget Builder: No coding required. Build your widget with a live preview.
  • Shortcode Support: Use [video_widget id="123"] to place your video anywhere.
  • Call to Action (CTA): Add a custom button to redirect users to your product or checkout page.
  • Basic Analytics: Track how many people viewed your video and clicked your CTA button.
  • Customization: Change colors, shapes (Circle/Square), and sizes for desktop and mobile.
  • Smart Animations: Includes a ‘Pulse’ animation to draw attention.
  • Behavior Control: Set auto-open, delay time, and “run once” (session-based).

Why use ChimpJar Shoppable Videos?

In today’s digital world, video is king. Static images are no longer enough. By adding a human face or a product demo video via a floating widget, you build trust and increase the likelihood of conversion by up to 30%.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chimpjar-shoppable-videos folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Video Widgets in your sidebar menu.
  4. Click Add New Widget, configure your settings, and save.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into your page or post.
sections.faq:
Does it support YouTube/Vimeo?

Yes! You can use direct video links (MP4), WordPress Media Library uploads, or YouTube video links.

Can I show multiple videos in one widget?

Yes! You can add multiple videos to your widget gallery repeater.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes! You can set different sizes for Desktop and Mobile to ensure it looks great on all screens.
